name: sticky-banner

frames.best_why: The banner is fully in view with its message and close icon, above readable blog content.

tagline: A bright blue announcement strip pinned across the top of the page.
summary: A full-width announcement bar that slides down at the top of the page, stays pinned while scrolling, and disappears when its close icon is clicked.
appearance: A saturated blue band spans the top of the page with small white text and an underlined link, plus a small white X at the right end. Below it sits a dark blog page with photos and article text.
behaviour: The bar drops in from above on load, stays sticky at the top as the page scrolls, and slides back out of view when the X is clicked. It can also hide itself on scroll when that option is on.
demo_content: The line 'Announcing our $12M Series A, led by Northzone. Read the announcement' above a Northwind blog.
search_phrases: top bar that hides on scroll
small alert with a close button
use_when: A launch, funding or sale deserves a one-line note across the top of every page.
avoid_when: The bright sticky band covers content and can nag on mobile unless hide-on-scroll is enabled.
customise: Content is children; className sets the colours and hideOnScroll adds scroll-away behaviour. Duration, offsets and the close icon live in the source.
weight_why: One scroll listener plus short translate and opacity transitions.

a11y.note: The close button is labelled and focusable, but the bar vanishes without notice and ignores reduced-motion.

polish_why: Clean blue bar with a clear action; nothing distinctive beyond the sticky behaviour.
